thread:
alexa: Quick follow-up to the service-auth namespace RFC — mounting question: should we split service keys per org or keep a single global namespace? Need migration path + how audit hooks tie in.
kamal: leaning per-org. simpler for admin scoping and limits. cross-org svc-to-svc calls become explicit policy decisions.
maria: per-org helps RBAC but increases lookup complexity. audit hooks are must — we should log mint/rotate with org/id and action.
sanjay: +1 per-org but watch cross-project proxies. we have existing proxies that assume global keys.
alexa: sanjay — do you mean the sentinel proxy? what's the specific breakage mode?
sanjay: yes sentinel. it currently accepts keys without org prefix. if we put keys behind orgs, sentinel needs to check "org header" or token format.
kamal: what about token prefixes? e.g., `org_{orgid}_svc_{rand}` so forward-compatible and cheap parsing.
maria: token shape is ok. but watch DB indexes. adding prefix increases cardinality on the left; we should index suffix or store metadata separate.
kamal: agree. store token metadata (svc_id, org_id, created_at) in a metadata table and keep token hash for auth. parsing prefix only for routing, not auth lookup.
alexa: audit hook design: we want an append-only stream to internal logging (kinesis/evt). fields: actor, org, svc_id, action, reason, request_id. maria can you draft payload?
maria: will do. also add `key_rotation` field and `rotation_origin` (manual/auto) — helps investigations.
opsbot: deploy: config change pushed to sentinel canary (svc-auth-ns flag) — 3345678908
kamal: for migration: phased approach: 1) support org-prefixed tokens while still accepting global tokens; 2) emit deprecation logs + metric; 3) issue rotated org-scoped tokens for migrated services; 4) hard reject after X.
alexa: good. need to decide TTL for migration window and how we rotate service secrets (KMS flow?).
sanjay: TTL 90 days seems reasonable. rotation via KMS envelope + rotation job that posts audit hook for each rotate.
kamal: one more edge: role bindings that reference service actor — do we require role -> org binding? some customers expect cross-org service access (partners). we need a policy exception flow.
maria: implement org-scoped RBAC by default and special cross-org grants via "external_trust" flag + explicit approval workflow. audit logs should include approver id.
alexa: ok. ops: please add RFC addendum with migration steps + audit payload spec. schedule arch sync next Tues.
opsbot: calendar invite sent: Arch Sync — Service Auth Namespace Migration — Tue 09:00
alexa: thanks everyone. I'll start the draft and ping once ready. :thumbsup:
